method: Candidate pairs from a 16x16 difference hash on the inner 80% of each woodcut crop (ranks 1-24 inspected, distances 43-100; the rest are >= 100 against a median of 125) and from a 9x8 difference hash <= 6 (two pairs); every pair confirmed or rejected by eye by the orchestrator on side-by-side crops, before any coding. Hand-colouring differs between copies of a reused block.
